author: GamingBolt
description:
In the eight years since the original release of Kingdom Come: Deliverance, plenty has happened in the world, from an entirely new console generation to a global pandemic. Throughout all of this, the open-world RPG has remained one of the most unique games out there, surpassed only by its own sequel. 

However, its original version has long been haunted by poor console performance. Now, however, with the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S upgrades, Kingdom Come: Deliverance finally feels like a great game to recommend to console gamers. The  upgraded visuals look phenomenal; Plenty of details are visible on everything from character models to animals and even armor. 

Combine that with the fantastic combat system and deep progression system that realistically rewards player perseverance, and you have a great way to spend dozens of hours.
title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 1 PS5 Review - A Proper Next-Gen Upgrade?

author: GamingBolt
description:
From its reveal last June to the torturous months of waiting and various teases, Resident Evil Requiem is finally upon us at long last. It's an auspicious occasion for many fans of the series – between 2026, marking the 30th anniversary of the series, we finally return to Raccoon City decades after its destruction - an event that would influence almost every single entry afterwards. There are secrets to discover, old friends to reunite with and new threats to conquer, but for long-time veterans, the rules of survival still apply.

Unlike prior entries, you're not just going all-out with guns blazing or simply slinking through environments, trying to save every single last bullet. Instead, Requiem combines the two playstyles. And it can be downright delicious, even as you fight for your life.

Let's dive into 15 things you should know when playing Requiem and how to emerge unscathed from the nightmares within.
title: 15 Beginners Tips And Tricks Resident Evil Requiem Doesn't Tell You
